title: Breakspell
summary: Breakspell is a spell used for breaking various enchantments, seals and illusions. This spell shoots a blue beam at the source of magical energy. If the enchantment is too strong, then it will only be temporarily broken. Some enchantments may be so strong as to render Breakspell futile against them.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sophie Casterwill used Breakspell to destroy the Gargoyle trap protecting the Cave of the Gargoyle. [Into the River of Secrets]

Inside the Paris Catacombs, Breakspell was used by Sophie alongside other spells to deactivate the Knights of Arc's Inner Circle protecting the Ring of Arc, targeting every individual suit of armor. This left her exhausted afterwards. [Crawling the Catacombs]

Sophie again used this spell to break a mystical laminate preventing Cypherdex from scanning a map of the inner maze of the Basilisk House. The laminate was set by DeFoe as a trap, predicting the Huntik team would attempt to scan the map. [Absent Heroes]

Zhalia Moon and Sophie Casterwill undid the petrifying effects of King Basilisk with this spell. [Huntik.com]

Breakspell was cast by Sophie Casterwill to break a magical barrier surrounding a ship sunk in the Stavropolous River initially thought to be the Argo, allowing the Huntik team to explore it. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Sophie once again used the spell counter the illusion of Cristine, set by the Titan Madea to give Sophie fake books about her family's history. [The Beautiful Trap]

This spell was cast by Sophie in order to open a chamber inside the Newgrange Passage Tomb containing the Titan Gybolg. As Sophie had noted when she used the spell, the door opened after a short time, trapping Lok on the outside of the room fighting Organization Suits. She attempted to cast Breakspell again, but the seal was much stronger from the inside and the door couldn't be open. [Home Turf]

Breakspell was unsuccessfully cast by Sophie Casterwill to attempt to break a powerful force barrier shielding a cave Lok Lambert had fallen into. The barrier was set ten years ago by Eathon Lambert to protect The Oracle, residing in the cave. [The Unseen Guide]

In an unofficial mission to confront Simon Judeau in his castle, Sophie used the spell to destroy a cat-like anchor concealing the various traps guarding the entrance to the castle. The Professor also used Breakspell to break an illusion and reveal his true appearance to the Huntik team because of the Curse of the Legendary Titans. [The Divine Comedy] Sophie later cast Breakspell once again in combination with Lok Lambert's Boltflare to break the Professor's ritual regarding the Amulet of Will and Behemoth, Tao and Araknos. [The Mission]

At one point, Zhalia Moon used the spell against a Suit. [TCG:SAS-104]

As part of a plan to get inside Medusa's Cave, Sophie used Breakspell to stop Kiel from casting one of his powers, helping Metagolem detain him. [Zhalia's Mission]

Sophie used this spell once again against Kiel to stop one of his spells when fighting him by the entrance of the Fortress of Iron Will. [The Spiral War]

In an elaborate plan to capture Rassimov by the Tomb of Tutankhamun, Sophie cast Breakspell to prevent him from using one of his powers. [Rassimov's Secret]

After asking Cherit to give her all his power with his Energy Charge, Sophie Casterwill used Breakspell with Doublespell on the Spiral Mark in an attempt to stop the dark ritual sending the Red Comet to their location. However, the ritual was too strong and Sophie's efforts were in vain. [The Spiral Mark]
